notes: No global publisher isolation or automatic relocation.

Live mode requires BOTH explicit env switch and a manually reviewed URL/place manifest.

d19_correction_integrity.note: Hypothetical deletions are never published. Full article review and an upstream metrics rebuild are required before live activation. Capped groups are not simulated as safely deletable.

d191_feed_resilience.note: Snapshot health uses serialized article count as a conservative proxy. An old snapshot is not preserved forever; age limit is 30 hours.

frozen_outage_drills.note: Synthetic in-memory scenarios confirm gate decisions and snapshot immutability; they do not simulate network fetches, GitHub commits, or guarantee future source availability.

limits: A successful HTTP response with zero parsed items is not a transport failure; it can still represent an upstream empty or malformed response.
